sections.heading: Certificate of Surety
sections.body: This is to certify that Deccan Shield Insurance Limited, the Surety named in the Schedule above, has issued this Contract Performance Bond on behalf of the Principal in favour of the Obligee in respect of the contract for construction of stormwater drains, road resurfacing and allied civil works in Zone IV, Lucknow, as referenced in the Schedule. The Surety undertakes to pay the Obligee, on first written demand, any sum or sums not exceeding the Bond Amount stated in the Schedule, upon the Obligee certifying that the Principal has failed to perform its obligations under the said contract.

sections.heading: Conditions of the Bond
sections.body: 1. The liability of the Surety shall not exceed the Bond Amount stated in the Schedule under any circumstances. 2. Any demand under this bond must be made in writing on the Obligee's letterhead, signed by an authorised officer, and received at the Surety's issuing office within the validity period or the claim lodgement period stated herein. 3. This bond shall not be affected by any change in the constitution of the Principal, the Surety or the Obligee. 4. No extension of time or variation in contract terms granted by the Obligee shall discharge the Surety, provided the Surety is intimated in writing. 5. This bond is governed by the laws of India and subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Lucknow.

sections.heading: Indemnity and Recourse
sections.body: The Principal has executed a Deed of Indemnity in favour of the Surety and agrees to reimburse the Surety for any amount paid under this bond together with costs and expenses incurred. The Surety reserves its right of recourse against the Principal and its promoter-guarantors in terms of the said Deed of Indemnity.

sections.heading: Verification
sections.body: The authenticity of this certificate may be verified by writing to suretyverify@deccanshield.example.in or by calling the Surety Desk on 0522-4093 7710, quoting the Surety Bond Number. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. This product is filed with IRDAI under the UIN shown above.

sections.heading: Grievance Redressal
sections.body: For any grievance, the Principal or Obligee may contact the Grievance Officer, Deccan Shield Insurance Limited, at grievance@deccanshield.example.in. If unresolved within 15 days, the matter may be escalated through the Bima Bharosa portal or to the Insurance Ombudsman having jurisdiction over Lucknow.
